label: Basic Blocs
description: Install neutral official UI blocs used by other integrations.

instructions: CmsCore imports the neutral UI blocs used as shared building blocks by official integrations.
The blocs inherit typography and expose CSS custom properties and parts for site-level themes.
checks: No source, secret, connector, or dashboard is installed.
Existing blocs require force when re-importing.
The imported source remains editable in the site bloc folder.
review: Use these blocs as neutral defaults for official integration UI.
Override visual treatment through the site theme before creating specialized copies.
ui.syncNote: This integration installs only bloc artifacts.
